{{Quote|Not long ago some bored, unattended Howler Tree children got hold of a Larynx-7 aboard one of the transgalactic starliners. With it they commanded the entire droid service crew to engage in a cabinwide food fight, forcing the pilot to terminate the flight in the Gulf of Tatooine so that the staff could clean the cockpit windshield.|Ebenn Q3 Baobab, ''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide''|<ref name="PhraseBook">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>}}
The '''Gulf of Tatooine''' was a near-[[Star/Legends|starless]] region that formed a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]]. The [[Trans Gulf Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] traversed the area, with the [[Vuzsa system/Legends|Vuzsa system]] being located on the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route. At some point by [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|transgalactic]] [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliner]] was forced to stop at the Gulf of Tatooine so that its crew could clean the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]] after it had become obscured as a result of a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] fight initiated by the vessel's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] service crew.

==Description==
The Gulf of Tatooine was a nearly [[Star/Legends|starless]] void located in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]], a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It bordered the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] Rimward, the [[D'Anjon Nebula/Legends|D'Anjon Nebula]] [[spinward]], and the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Old Corellian Run]] in the [[trailing]] direction. The [[Trans Gulf Route]] hyperlane traveled across the Gulf of Tatooine, connecting the [[Pii system/Legends|Pii]] and [[Piroket system/Legends|Piroket systems]]. The region shared its name with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which was situated at the intersection of the Triellus and the Old Corellian Run.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|So be cautioned, never let a Baobab Larynx-7 fall into the hands of children. It is not a toy, and should be operated only by adults.|Ebenn Q3 Baobab, ''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide''|<ref name="PhraseBook" />}}
At some point by [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], a group of<ref name="PhraseBook" /> [[Howler Tree People]]<ref name="Lost Ones">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Lost Ones]]''</ref> [[Youngling/Legends|children]] traveling aboard a [[The galaxy/Legends|transgalactic]] [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliner]] obtained a [[Baobab Larynx-7]] [[Whistle/Legends|reed whistle]] that could be used to communicate in [[Binary/Legends|droidspeak]]. The children then used the whistle to command the entire [[Droid/Legends|droid]] service crew of the [[Starship/Legends|starliner]] to commence a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] fight. The [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]] of the vessel's [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] became obscured as a result, and the starship's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was forced to end the flight in the Gulf of Tatooine, where the liner's crew could then clean the viewport. Shortly thereafter, the [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]] noted the incident in the 6 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] edition of his [[Book/Legends|book]] the ''[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide]]''.<ref name="PhraseBook" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|When I was nearly captured in the Lorn system some time ago, it was the Sandwind operatives who helped me find the Vuzsa safehouse and hole up until Moff Murquan gave up on me&hellip;|Tiree, personal addendum to Rebel [[Task Force on Alliance Security]]'s [[SecuriDex]] [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] on the "[[Jundland Banshee]]"|<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>}}
The [[Vuzsa system/Legends|Vuzsa system]] was situated on the Trans Gulf Route at the center of the Gulf of Tatooine. It contained the world [[Vuzsa/Legends|Vuzsa]], which served as a [[Fuel/Legends|refueling]] point for starships traveling between the Pii and Piroket [[Star system/Legends|systems]]&mdash;which occasionally did so via the Trans Gulf Route in order to avoid the seedy [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] of Tatooine.<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] maintained a [[Vuzsa safehouse|safehouse]] at Vuzsa, at which the Rebel agent [[Tay Vanis|Tiree]] once hid in order to evade capture by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gulf of Tatooine was first mentioned in the [[2001]] book [[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']], authored by [[Ben Burtt]].<ref name="PhraseBook" /> It was illustrated on a map designed by [[Modi]] and included in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square R-16.<ref name="TEA" />
